min_standing_note.value: Bachelor exchange students are strongly advised to have completed their first 2 years before exchange; Master-level BSS courses require a completed Bachelor's degree and sufficient academic background.
min_standing_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Groningen/Fact Sheet Faculty BSS, University of Groningen 2026-27.pdf#page=2

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Merged rows [121, 136]: agreement scope is 'Psychology and Sociology' (both under AUC HUSS), corresponding to UG's Faculty of Behavioural and Social Sciences (BSS); Drive folder also contains a Faculty of Arts 2026-2027 factsheet.

eligible_majors.notes: Excel row 121 specifies 'Psychology and Sociology'; BSS 2026-2027 fact sheet page 2 confirms students must major in Psychology, Sociology, or Pedagogical/Educational Sciences.

instruction_languages.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Groningen/Fact Sheet Faculty BSS, University of Groningen 2026-27.pdf#page=2

english_course_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Groningen/Fact Sheet Faculty BSS, University of Groningen 2026-27.pdf#page=2
english_course_availability.notes: Extensive English-taught undergraduate and graduate offerings in BSS (and Arts).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Faculty of BSS requires CEFR B2 English for Bachelor courses and C1 for Master courses (Faculty of Arts requires B2/C1: IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 92, or C1/IELTS 7.0–8.0 / TOEFL 100–110 for selected MA tracks).
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Groningen/Fact Sheet Faculty BSS, University of Groningen 2026-27.pdf#page=2
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: Language proof details: https://www.rug.nl/gmw/exchange/how_to_apply/language-requirements; Faculty of Arts thresholds in UoGronigen/2026-2027/Factsheet 2026-2027.pdf#page=3.

host_language_requirement.value: None for English-taught courses (CEFR B2/C1 Dutch required only for Dutch-taught courses).

fall_term_dates.value: Autumn Semester: September – January (expected arrival last week of August; see https://www.rug.nl/gmw/exchange/academic_calender/).
fall_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Groningen/Fact Sheet Faculty BSS, University of Groningen 2026-27.pdf#page=2

spring_term_dates.value: Spring Semester: February – June/July (expected arrival last week of January; CRITICAL: Sociology exchange courses in BSS are ONLY offered in Autumn semester!).
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Groningen/Fact Sheet Faculty BSS, University of Groningen 2026-27.pdf#page=2
spring_term_dates.notes: Autumn-only Sociology restriction stated on BSS 2026-2027 fact sheet page 3.

tuition_model.notes: Incoming exchange students are not required to pay tuition fees to the University of Groningen.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: RUG estimates average student living expenses at €800–€1,000/month excluding tuition (separate annual IND living-money standard applies to non-EU visa permits).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month exchange semester estimate: midpoint 900 EUR/month (range 800–1000 EUR) * 5 months * 1.1052 = 4973.40 USD using ECB 2026-11-13 rate (1 EUR = 1.1052 USD, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html, collected 2026-11-15).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Sufficient health insurance coverage is obligatory during the exchange (https://www.rug.nl/education/exchange/financial-matters/health-insurance-for-exchange-students); travel & third-party liability insurance strongly advised.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Groningen/Fact Sheet Faculty BSS, University of Groningen 2026-27.pdf#page=3

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Groningen/Fact Sheet Faculty BSS, University of Groningen 2026-27.pdf#page=3
housing_availability.notes: UG is not a campus university and does not own student dorms; reserved short-stay international rooms via SSH (https://www.sshxl.nl/en) plus At Home in Groningen / Hospi Housing; rooms fill quickly.

housing_notes.value: No campus-owned dorms; UG reserves short-stay rooms via SSH (https://www.sshxl.nl/en), plus At Home in Groningen; book as early as possible after admission.
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Groningen/Fact Sheet Faculty BSS, University of Groningen 2026-27.pdf#page=3

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: University of Groningen Immigration Service Desk contacts admitted non-EU/EEA students with MVV/residence permit instructions (https://www.rug.nl/education/exchange/visa-and-immigration/); Dutch IND financial proof applies.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Groningen/Fact Sheet Faculty BSS, University of Groningen 2026-27.pdf#page=3

exchange_page_url.notes: General UG incoming portal: https://www.rug.nl/education/incoming-students/; Faculty of Arts: www.rug.nl/arts-exchange.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system (1 EC = 28 hours); normal workload 15 EC per block / 30 EC per semester.
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Groningen/Fact Sheet Faculty BSS, University of Groningen 2026-27.pdf#page=3

course_restrictions_note.value: BSS exchange students must major in Psychology, Sociology, or Pedagogical/Educational Sciences; Sociology & Pedagogical/Educational Sciences courses are offered ONLY in Autumn semester; no guarantee of taking courses at other faculties; Sem 1b resits are held in Groningen in April only (no remote exams).
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Groningen/Fact Sheet Faculty BSS, University of Groningen 2026-27.pdf#page=2
course_restrictions_note.notes: Page 3 details Autumn-only Sociology, no external faculty guarantees, and in-person April resits.

international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Groningen/Fact Sheet Faculty BSS, University of Groningen 2026-27.pdf#page=3
international_support_services.notes: Welcoming ceremony / introduction week on Arts 2026-2027 fact sheet page 7.

nomination_deadlines.value: BSS 2026-2027: Autumn Nom May 1 (App: Non-EU May 15 / EU Jun 1); Spring Nom Oct 1 (App: Non-EU Oct 15 / EU Nov 1 — Sociology Autumn-only). Arts 2026-2027: Non-EU Nom Apr 15 / App May 1 (Fall) and Nom Sep 15 / App Oct 1 (Spring).
